LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASS: DETERMINERS: QUANTIFIERS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Which words do we use to show amount or quantity? 2. Why is it important to tell the quantity of something?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-Efficacy: as learners use quantifying determiners in sentences correctly.

• Communication and Collaboration: Team work learners work in groups and pairs.

• Digital Literacy: Interacting with digital technology as learners use the internet to sign read sentences containing quantifying determiners.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation: as learners’ complete pair and group tasks involving the use of quantifiers.

Link to other Subjects:

The learner uses the knowledge of quantifying determiners to learn similar concepts in Kiswahili and Kenya Sign Language.
